## Appearance

Allan possesses clear, bright, and true eyes. Fine, patient lines are visible around her eyes and mouth.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P27](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0027)_

## Personality

Allan is a cheerful young man known for his high ideals. He is widely liked by both the young and the old for his frank nature.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006)_

## History

Mr. Allan arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) as the community's new minister, moving into the manse with his wife. He later attended the garden wedding of Miss Lavendar and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) alongside guests such as [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). Following the ceremony, he joined the other attendees in seeing the newly married couple off at the train station.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Mrs. Allan serves as a trusted friend, minister's wife, and Sunday school teacher to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their relationship began on a warm note despite an early mishap where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally flavored a layer cake with liniment, a blunder Mrs. Allan handled with gracious kindness by comforting the embarrassed girl. Over time, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) continues to adore Mrs. Allan, enjoying hosted visits to the manse and seeking her companionship as she matures through her school years.

- Friend of — minister's wife and confidante  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P26](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0026)</sub>
